summaryForNext: Scope is 6 hooks, not 31: every upstream id inventoried per-id with payload, timeout and verdict - 6 PORT + 22 DEFER + 3 DROP = 31, each row cross-checked against hooks.json (id, event, timeout) and hook-dispatch-v1.sh (payload), 0 mismatches. PORT: sessionstart-kbd-control, sessionstart-detect-project-context, posttool-write-position-reminder, subagent-fallback-checkpoint, taskcompleted-kbd-receipt, precompact-kbd-control. 8 candidates (cand-101..108): 5 adopt, 3 reject. Every adopt is stdlib or a design choice, so the phase adds ZERO runtime dependencies. tinybench and mitata rejected on fit (in-process throughput, not process cold start), not health. DESIGN CONSTRAINT for spec/plan: the static import map and the manifest test must key on the --hook argument, never the matcher-level id - id is per-matcher (4 of 14 entries carry it) and cannot address an individual hook. BLOCKING OPEN QUESTION: does this harness accept exec form (command + args) in a project hooks.json? Unresolved; recorded as build_required[0]. No research tier can settle it. Plan's first task after the goal-1 re-review must be a probe registering one trivial exec-form hook. If exec form is unsupported the design inverts, because a shell string puts sh -c / PowerShell back in the hook path, which C1 and C3 forbid. MEASUREMENT SCOPE WIDENED: three ported hooks carry the 1s budget, not the two goals.md names - precompact-kbd-control is also 1000ms and must be measured. STILL BLOCKING before execute: goal 1 (re-review the 4 unreviewed lib/platform fixes, 8 UNREVIEWED markers), and the operator decision on artifact-refiner in or out of the QA contract. Review: round 1 BLOCK (1 CRITICAL, 1 WARNING) -> round 2 PASS (1 WARNING, 2 SUGGESTIONs, all three fixed after the verdict). The WARNING was an uncited python3 dependency behind 14 DEFER verdicts; closed by VERIFYING it at canonical source paths and adding line citations, not by softening the wording. Self-review by mutation also caught a third defect the round-1 judge missed (a literal || in row 2 splitting the markdown row). JUDGE CAVEAT: the liter-llm gateway answered /health 200 but rejected /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions with 'Missing or invalid Authorization header', and no credential was present in the environment or any config path the bridge reads. The judge was therefore a fresh-context subagent from the producer's own model family: cross_model_check is NOT verified-distinct, which is a weaker check than the cross-model path.
